input.cut: eafc, fm, transfermarkt, fifa, sofifa and national_football_teams providers of bridges.csv

source.note: Reep v1 bridges.csv, eafc and fm player bridges only. eafc ids are EA/SoFIFA player_ids, fm ids FM unique ids (EFEM ids). Only ids present in a committed EA CSV or FM snapshot of REEP_SOURCES (scripts/lib/reep-bridge.mjs) are kept; re-run npm run sync:reep-bridge when a snapshot changes. The release manifest reports deterministic_quality.passed: false, so each EA–FM link is checked for a shared surname and an FM age within a year of the EA birth date; failures are listed under rejected and their FM id leaves the person. Reep withholds people under 18. CC0 covers Reep's compilation, not the third-party source data.
